title: Ollama Model Size for Your RAM: Which One Fits?
description:
Will your local AI model fit your RAM? Check before you pull. ⚡

✅ Model size plus headroom is the RAM you need
✅ 8 GB RAM: pull the 3b, 16 GB RAM: pull the 7b
✅ Run ollama list to see each model's size
